recipes.name: Snow on the Mountain Green Beans
ingredients_raw: sea salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add green beans, and cook uncovered until just tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Meanwhile, melt the butter with the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. When the beans are almost tender, drain and add to the skillet. Continue cooking the green beans in the butter until they are tender, about 2 minutes more.
Season the beans with salt, pepper, and lemon juice. Place onto a warmed serving dish, and sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese.

raw_recipe.headline: Snow on the Mountain Green Beans
raw_recipe.description: This is a side dish of fresh green beans cooked in olive oil and lemon juice and topped with feta cheese.

review.reviewBody: N*R I didnt' think I was going to like this, since I hate green beans, but my family likes them, and loves feta. They RAVED over it, so I tried it. Turns out, I only hate BAD green beans! These are GREAT, and how our family will fix green beans from here on out!!!

I halved this recipe for just two. I boiled the beans in chicken bouillon. Be sure not to overcook the beans since you are going to cook them a little in the frying pan. I put 2 T. EVOO in the frying pan along with 2 cloves of minced garlic. I cooked the garlic for a little while and then added the drained beans. I poured a couple of teaspoons of rice vinegar on it along with the sea salt and pepper. I also squeezed a couple of lemon wedges over the bean/garlic mixture. Then after mixing all well I topped with the feta and let sit for about 5 min. until the feta warmed up some. I think next time I'll use a little lemon zest too. This was wonderfu.

We really enjoyed this recipe! The cooking method is the ONLY way I will prepare my fresh green beans from now on. I tweaked it a little bit to accommodate dairy allergies. I have a huge skillet so I was able to boil the beans in the skillet first, which saved having to use 2 pans. Then I saute'd very thin slices of red onion in coconut oil (no butter) for about 2-3 minutes. Seasoned as described to taste, but I use Crystallized Lemon instead of the juice. You can find it in the spice section...I LOVE to use this powder in so many things! The brand is called TRUE lemon. They also sell a lime one too! Carrie thanks for sharing!
The lemon with the beans gives a wonderful flavour. I sauteed white onions and fresh garlic and added them to the mix. Very yummy and super healthy -- you can make double and reheat the next day.

Superb! Loved the flavors of the fresh lemon with the feta cheese. I steamed the green beans in a bag in the microwave rather than boiling. I added some chopped garlic to the skillet with the butter and EVOO. I used the garlic herb flavored feta for added flavor. This dish will make a wonderful accent to so many different main courses. I will use this often. Thanks for sharing such a fresh and delicious recipe. N*R

I add lemon pepper to the butter/evoo and some fennel seeds as well and cooked them until the seeds popped, then I add the beans and some sundried tomatoes as well. Everyone forgot about the main course and gobbled up these scrumptious veggies!
This was really good! I used Trader Joe's French green beans and only wish I dried them more after boiling them. I ended up adding more butter because they were more watery than I wanted.

We thought this was a really fresh, tasty way of making green beans. It was very simple to prepare, although I skipped a step to reduce dishes. I drained my beans and just used the pot I boiled them in to complete the dish. Excellent, THX> N*R
Really tasty. I omitted the butter, instead using some olive oil to which I added a finely diced shallot until fragrant and slight touch of salt. It was a nice, simple and healthy side dish.
My family loves these! it is one of our go-tos. When I am short on time, I blanch the beans with lemon juice and then sprinkle the feta over the top. Not as rich of a flavor but it tastes great, too.
This is a nice green bean side dish with a Mediterranean flair. But to me, butter doesn't belong here. So I skipped it and doubled the olive oil. Also added some garlic.
Great, added garlic!
Fresh and better tasting than I thought it would be. And I normally hate green beans!
Tasty recipe and something a little different.
Loved the recipe. Added a few sliced almond but it was great without as well
A family favorite!
easy to make and kids like these beans. good for a big family gathering.
Awesome

I like green beans but really need something on or mixed in with them. The first time I made this I LOVED IT! And.....the 50th time I made this I LOVED IT! If you like feta cheese this is awesome. thanks for sharing
I love this! I had no idea the lemon and feta could give it such a light fresh taste. I wonder if it would still be as good if you added garlic
